{{Quote|An unexplored world is a hostile world. I must help the Wookiee leader Attichitcuk to learn the lay of the land. Only then can we find an appropriate place to settle.|Qui-Gon Jinn|audio=HelpingAttichitcuk.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
The [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] '''colonists''' were a group, mostly made up of [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], who between [[39 BBY/Legends|39]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]] colonized the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] Alaris Prime. The Wookiees were aided by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] in the colony, and also had to [[Alaris Prime colonial war|battle]] the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] for the rights to the moon.

==Description==
{{Quote|Give a Wookiee bantha meat and he'll eat for a day. Teach a Wookiee to hunt bantha and he'll eat for a lifetime.|Qui-Gon Jinn|audio=BanthaWookiees.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
The [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]] of [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]], a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Alaris/Legends|Alaris]], included workers and [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]]. The workers used various pieces of technology to gather the natural resources of the moon, and constructed different building types for various purposes. The warriors included [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] such as [[bowcaster trooper]]s, and the Wookiees built up their military capabilities to include mechs, heavy weapons, and [[Starship/Legends|ships]].<ref name="GB" /> On Alaris Prime, the Wookiees domesticated the [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Maru/Legends|maru]] as pack [[Species/Legends|animals]] and war mounts.<ref name="Unknown">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref> The Wookiees colonized the other seven moons of Alaris,<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> with settlements that used the middle-period [[Krorral]] archtectural style.<ref name="Geonosis">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>

==History==
===The colonization of Alaris Prime===
====The landing====
{{Quote|Before we unload workers and equipment, Chewbacca and his friend Shoran need to scout the area.|Qui-Gon Jinn|audio=ShoranAndChewie.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:Chewie_and_Shoran.png|thumb|right|250px|Chewbacca and Shoran were among the first Wookiees to set foot on Alaris Prime.]]
Between [[59 BBY/Legends|59 BBY]] and [[56 BBY/Legends|56 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the [[Alaris Prime colonial war|war]] for [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]], and the ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' DataBank states that the debate for Alaris Prime's [[Alaris Prime colonization resolution|rights]] took place over a twenty [[Standard year/Legends|year]] period following its [[Discovery of Alaris Prime|rediscovery]], meaning that event took place between [[59 BBY/Legends|59 BBY]] and [[56 BBY/Legends|56 BBY]].</ref> Alaris Prime, which had been hidden from [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] view by the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] and was thus untouched by civilization, was [[Discovery of Alaris Prime|discovered]] by Wookiee [[Scout/Legends|explorers]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] in the same [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|star system]]. The explorers petitioned the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] on behalf of Kashyyyk, represented by the [[Wookiee Chieftain|Chieftain]] [[Attichitcuk/Legends|Attichitcuk]]. After twenty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of debate, including opposition from the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], the colonization rights were finally [[Alaris Prime colonization resolution|awarded]] to the Wookiees. Attichitcuk was granted leadership of the colonists for [[Gender/Legends|his]] role in securing the rights. The colonists departed for Alaris Prime aboard four [[Colony ship/Legends|colony ships]], including the ''[[Thalmussen]]'',<ref name="GB" /> between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]].<ref name="NEC39" /> Among the colonists was [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], Attichitcuk's [[Reproduction/Legends|son]], and<ref name="GB" /> Chewbacca's cousin<ref name="TT">''[[Tyrant's Test]]''</ref> [[Shoran]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] was also assigned by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] to advise the Wookiees in their efforts at colonization.<ref name="GB" />

Attichitcuk was the first Wookiee to disembark the colony ships, he established a [[Attichitcuk's camp|camp]] and left [[marker]]s behind so other Wookiees to follow him. Shoran followed, also leaving markers, but stopped when he encountered a damaged [[Power core/Legends|power core]], unaware that it had been left by the Trade Federation, who had commenced an illegal colonization effort but had been driven from that area by [[Gundark/Legends|gundarks]], a predatory [[Species/Legends|species]] found on Alaris Prime. Chewbacca left the ships next, and followed the markers with Jinn's help until he found Shoran. On the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] recommendation the two destroyed the power core with their [[Bowcaster/Legends|bowcasters]]. Afterwards they proceeded until they found Attichitcuk's camp, and the three Wookiees had to quickly defend it from an [[Attack on Attichitcuk's camp|attack]] by gundarks.<ref name="GB" />

====Taming the frontier====
{{Quote|The wind carries with it the threat of an attack. My Wookiee friends have barely learned to harvest food, and yet now I must somehow teach them to create a militia. This will be a great challenge. May the Force be with them.|Qui-Gon Jinn on the training of bowcaster troopers prior to the attack on the gundark nest|audio=TrainingWarriors.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
Subsequently, more Wookiees departed their transports and began learning how to gather resources with Jinn's help. At a [[Unidentified Wookiee command center|command center]] three Wookiee workers began gathering [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] from [[Muja fruit/Legends|muja fruit]] [[Bush/Legends|bushes]], and two more later joined them and also caught [[Fish/Legends|fish]] from the nearby [[Water/Legends|river]]. Jinn had the Wookiees practice a drill in case of a gundark attack, which involved the Wookiees entering the command center for safety and using its [[Autoturret/Legends|autoturret]] for protection. After doing so, the Wookiees started gathering [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]] from [[Tree/Legends|trees]], and Chewbacca arrived at the command center. At that [[Time/Legends|time]], four gundarks [[Attack on the Wookiee command center|attacked]] the [[command center]], and the workers garrisoned inside the command center and Chewbacca helped [[Death/Legends|kill]] the gundarks. Chewbacca then found stockpiles of nova crystals and ore, from which the workers began gathering. After gathering a set threshold of resources, including [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystals]] and [[Ore/Legends|ore]] the command center was able to sustain itself.<ref name="GB" />

[[File:Gundark_nest.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The encounter with the Trade Federation changed the course of the Wookiees' work on Alaris Prime.]]
Jinn decided that the gundarks needed to be eliminated, and at another [[Unidentified Wookiee base (gundark attack)|base]] run by Chewbacca he set three workers to gather food and carbon. They also constructed [[prefab shelter]]s to allow more Wookiees to join them<ref name="GB" /> and Chewbacca found several [[Nerf/Legends|nerfs]] which the Wookiees were able to keep in an [[animal nursery]]. Once Chewbacca had trained at least ten [[bowcaster trooper]]s,<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> they marched northward to the [[Unidentified gundark nest|gundark nest]], only to find it already under [[Skirmish at the gundark nest|attack]] by [[Battle Droid Beta Version]]s of the Trade Federation, who had blamed the gundarks for the destruction of the power core. After all the gundarks were dead, the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] turned on the Wookiees, who were able to fight them off. Jinn congratulated the Wookiees for their performance, realizing that his lessons to them would take a dramatically different turn.<ref name="GB" />

====A change in leader====
{{Quote|Battlefield promotions are not easy to deal with, but Chewbacca handles the leadership role with a skill not often seen.|Qui-Gon Jinn, after Chewbacca took leadership of the colonists in his father's absence|audio=KingChewie.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:Alaris_Prime_colonists.png|thumb|right|300px|Chewbacca trained warriors to fight the Trade Federation.]]
Attichitcuk and two other Wookiees undertook a scouting mission to learn more about the Trade Federation's presence, while Chewbacca and seven other Wookiees worked on upgrading the worker's [[Armor/Legends|armor]], gathering food, and improving their [[technology level]]. After gathering enough food to advance their technology, Attichitcuk headed back to the [[Unidentified Wookiee base (Attichitcuk's rescue)|base]], but he was [[Ambush of Attichitcuk|ambushed]] by Battle Droid Beta Versions [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] by [[DRN-38]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droids]] killed his companions while Attichitcuk was left on the brink of death, with Jinn [[Force sense/Legends|sensing]] his survival through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Jinn instructed the Wookiees to train [[Bowcaster/Legends|bowcaster]] [[Troop/Legends|troopers]] and assemble a [[Unidentified Wookiee medical droid|medical droid]] so that they could [[Rescue of Attichitcuk|rescue]] their chieftain.<ref name="GB" />

With at least ten troopers ready,<ref name="Prima" /> Chewbacca gathered them at the [[marker]]s at the edge of the base before proceeding into the forests of Alaris Prime to rescue Attichitcuk. They destroyed several battle droids on their path before finding him and using the medical droid to heal him well enough to make the return journey to the base.<ref name="GB" /> Multiple bowcaster troopers were trained at the base and followed the path of Chewbacca's party, allowing them to make a two pronged attack on the droids as they returned with Attichitcuk. At the base, Attichitcuk entered its [[command center]],<ref name="Prima" /> and DRN-38 sent three [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]] to attack them, however, Chewbacca and the bowcaster troopers were able to hold them off. Chewbacca took leadership of the colonists while Attichitcuk took time to recover from his wounds.<ref name="GB" />

====Outpost attack====
{{Quote|He has decided on a perilous course. To show our resolve by raiding a nearby Trade Federation outpost. His hope is that they'll think twice before challenging us again.|Qui-Gon Jinn, referring to Chewbacca's plan to attack the outpost|audio=OutpostBriefing.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:Outpost_attacking.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The attack on the Trade Federation outpost]]
The Wookiees built another [[Unidentified Wookiee base (shipyard)|base]] in proximity to an [[Trade Federation outpost|outpost]] Chewbacca hoped to attack to delay the Trade Federation's production of battle droids.<ref name="GB" /> Chewbacca and two other Wookiees recruited twelve further workers to the base, they helped to expand it by building power cores, prefab shelters, and eventually a [[Food processing center]] and a [[Barracks/Legends|troop center]]. Chewbacca explored the surrounding area while two bowcaster troopers were trained. The Wookiees also built a [[Shipyard (water)|shipyard]] on the river and built a [[utility trawler]] there to gather fish, followed by a [[Sentry tower/Legends|sentry post]] and processing centers for storing carbon, nova, and ore. The utility trawler built an [[AquaHarvester]] to gather more fish, and then the Wookiees built a [[Mech/Legends|mech]] [[Factory/Legends|factory]], which they used to assemble two [[HummBike]] [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeders]].<ref name="Prima" />

Two Wookiees used the HummBikes to explore the forests surrounding the base,<ref name="Prima" /> and the absence of Trade Federation forces there led Jinn to correctly theorize that the outpost was on the other side of the river. The Wookiees built an aquatic [[Transport Ship (Wookiee)|transport ship]] to ferry the speeder riders across the river, where they found the outpost. Jinn ordered Chewbacca to gather an army of twelve Wookiees,<ref name="GB" /> including bowcaster troopers, [[dragon trooper]]s, and [[Thermal detonator trooper (Wookiee)|thermal detonator troopers]]. The group sailed across the river and approached the outpost, where the dragon troopers and [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]] troopers commenced the [[Attack on the Trade Federation outpost|attack]] by destroying the light outer wall. Five [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s commanded by [[GWC-04]] fired back at the Wookiees but were destroyed by Chewbacca and the bowcaster troopers.<ref name="Prima" /> The Wookiees were able to break through the wall and destroy the outpost.<ref name="GB" />

====Jedi and espionage====
{{Quote|You've won the day again! Chewbacca's strategies are bearing fruit.|Qui-Gon Jinn to the Wookiees after the attack on the Trade Federation listening array|audio=VictoryArray.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:Attack_on_the_listening_array.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Chewbacca led an attack on the Trade Federation's listening array.]]
Chewbacca established another [[Chewbacca's camp|camp]] south of a [[Shoran's camp|camp]] run by Shoran, although he was not immediately aware of the latter camp's exact location. He resided there with two bowcaster troopers, a dragon trooper, seven Wookiee workers, and two nerfs. Jinn instructed the Wookiees to gather resources while he lectured on the benefits of having allies. The Wookiees constructed a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], from which they were able to use [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] technology to locate Shoran's camp and then build [[Corellian HoverFreighter]]s to exchange resources. After Shoran found a [[Jedi holocron (Alaris Prime)|Jedi holocron]] inside his camp, Jinn requested and received permission from the Jedi Council to build a [[Jedi temple (Alaris Prime)|temple]] at Chewbacca's camp where the [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] should be stored. Upon the construction of the temple, Jinn sent his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to retrieve the holocron. Around that time, Shoran warned Chewbacca that the droid commander [[LUH-989]] had sent three [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|beetle droids]] and six Battle Droid Beta Versions to Chewbacca's camp.<ref name="GB" />

Jinn suggested that the Wookiee workers take refuge inside the camp's command center while a group<ref name="GB" /> of between five and six Wookiees<ref name="Prima" /> [[Attack on Chewbacca's camp|defended]] the camp and destroyed the droids. Chewbacca donated nova crystals to Shoran to help him recover from the attack. Kenobi returned to the camp with the holocron, and scouts from Shoran's camps uncovered a nearby [[Trade Federation listening array]], also commanded by LUH-989. The Wookiees and Jinn agreed to destroy the array, and Chewbacca gathered<ref name="GB" /> between eight and thirty Wookiees<ref name="Prima" /> to lead the attack. A heavy bowcaster trooper from Shoran's camp arrived at the array first and attacked its sentry posts, but was killed by the battle droids before the other Wookiees arrived. Once Chewbacca's forces and Shoran arrived they [[Attack on the Trade Federation listening array|destroyed]] the [[Transmitter/Legends|transmitters]] and B1 battle droids and droidekas.<ref name="GB" />

====The end of the war====
{{Quote|You've done it. The fortress is destroyed! The Trade Federation has lost its footing on Alaris Prime!|Qui-Gon Jinn, to the Wookiees|audio=WookieeVictory.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:Battle_for_Alaris_Prime.png|thumb|left|280px|The Battle for Alaris Prime saw the Wookiees drive the Trade Federation off their new world.]]
The Wookiees located the Trade Federation's main [[Unidentified Trade Federation base|base]] on Alaris Prime and established a new [[Unidentified Wookiee base (fortress)|base]], with Shoran constructing the defensive walls. Chewbacca and a fully recuperated Attichitcuk were at the base, along with eight workers, seven bowcaster troopers, two HummBike speeder scouts, and two dragon troopers. Jinn received permission from the Jedi Council to participate in the final [[Battle for Alaris Prime|offensive]] against the Trade Federation, which was given on the condition that the Wookiees construct a [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]]. The workers began to gather resources to upgrade their technology and filled the holes in the walls while Trade Federation commander [[SRAM-13]] sent battle droids to attack Wookiee sentry posts. When the Wookiees eventually built their fortress Jinn arrived at the base, after which SRAM-13 sent three [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] to scout the base. Jinn warned the Wookiees to prepare for an attack, but the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] did not initiate any violence.<ref name="GB" />

The Wookiees built turrets and an [[Airbase/Legends|airbase]], which they used to build ten [[Agr (starfighter)|Agr]] starfighters, three [[Blade bomber|Heavy Blade]] [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]]. They also built a heavy weapons factory where they assembled three [[Energy pummel/Legends|energy pummels]], and a mech factory to build five [[Sentinel (Wookiees)|Sentinels]]. Together with five bowcaster troopers, the vehicles, Wookiee leadership and Jinn marched towards the Trade Federation base. They destroyed the turrets on the path towards it, and the bombers destroyed the walls and turrets while the fighters picked off any droids they could find. With the path cleared for the ground forces, the Wookiee infantry entered the base and used the pummels to destroy the Trade Federation's fortress, ending their presence on Alaris Prime.<ref name="Prima" /> Afterward, Alaris Prime became a thriving technological hub for the Wookiees and the Republic,<ref name="GB" /> and gained [[Currency/Legends|economic]] success through Chewbacca's leadership.<ref name="Insider106">{{InsiderCite|106|Han Solo: The Early Years}}</ref>

===The Clone Wars===
{{Quote|He says the Separatists have invaded the entire moon and enslaved most of the Wookiee population. This is one of the last remaining villages. They're willing to help us get in contact with the Republic if we help them get the Separatists out of the star system.|Bera Kazan, translating for a Wookiee on Alaris Prime to Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="Clone Wars">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (video game)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' video game]]</ref>}}
Even with the victory on Alaris Prime,<ref name="GB" /> the Trade Federation continued to attack the colony worlds of Kashyyyk in the decades prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]],<ref name="Cross">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> which began in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. In the first month of the war,<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the Wookiees on Alaris Prime were targeted by the Confederacy, whose [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]], [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], wanted to test an ancient superweapon called the [[Force Harvester]] on a world where its devastating effects would not be noticed by the wider galaxy. When setting up a testing site to contain the Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], the smuggler [[Bera Kazan]], and several captive Wookiees, Dooku ordered his henchman [[Cydon Prax]] to exterminate any remaining Wookiees on Alaris Prime to conceal the existence of the Force Harvester.<ref name="Clone Wars" />

Skywalker used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to escape the Force Harvester, freeing Kazan and the Wookiee prisoners. In the [[battle on Alaris]], Skywalker fought back against the Separatists and repelled them from the moon.<ref name="Clone Wars" /> Shortly after the Alaris Prime Wookiees recovered from their enslavement, they were [[Battle of Alaris Prime (Hunt for the Decimator)|attacked]] again by the Separatist [[General/Legends|General]] [[Sev'rance Tann/Legends|Sev'rance Tann]], who need activation codes for stolen [[Decimator (war machine)|Decimators]].<ref name="CC">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The colonists of Alaris Prime were first mentioned in [[Prima Games]]' [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|strategy guide]] by [[Steven L. Kent]]<ref name="Prima" />&mdash;released on [[November 7]], [[2001]]<ref name="PrimaDate">{{Amazon|url=Star-Wars-Galactic-Battlegrounds-Official/dp/0761537503|text=Star Wars Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide}}</ref>&mdash;for the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'',<ref name="GB" /> released on [[November 11]], 2001.<ref name="GBDate">{{GameSpot|url=games/star-wars-galactic-battlegrounds|text=Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds}}</ref> In the game, the player controls them throughout the tutorial campaign, learning how to gather resources and build armies.<ref name="GB" />

In the [[2002]] video game [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (video game)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'']], several missions take place on a location called the Kashyyyk moon.<ref name="Clone Wars" /> The moon was suggested to be Alaris Prime on the LucasArts website, which mentioned the moon's previous appearance in ''Galactic Battlegrounds'',<ref name="Lucas">{{LucasArts|url=products/starwarstheclonewars/gameplay/kashyyyk.htm|text=Star Wars: The Clone Wars - Kashyyyk Moon}}</ref> and it was more explicitly confirmed in ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' in [[2005]].<ref name="NEC" />

The [[2015]] [[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|Core Rulebook]] for the [[roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny]]'' stated that Alaris Prime was terraformed by Wookiee colonists to resemble Kashyyyk over [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]].<ref name="Force and Destiny">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> This contradicts the portrayal of Alaris Prime as a previously unknown world shown in ''Galactic Battlegrounds'',<ref name="GB" /> [[The Official Star Wars Fact File 42|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' 42]],<ref name="Fact">{{FactFile|42|KAS 1-4|Kashyyyk}}</ref> and ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="Encyclopedia">{{CSWECite|I|17|Alaris Prime}}</ref>
